ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Question: 433
A teacher at a community college is expecting that 10% of her class will get an A on their exam, 15% will get a B, 35% will get a C, 25% will get a D, while 15% will get an F. All of the students participated in the exam. The actual values were that 22 students got an A, 18 got a B, 25 got a C, 15 got a D, and 20 failed the test and got an F. Which of the following is the correct chi-square statistic?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A teacher at a community college expects that 10% of her class will get an A on their exam, 15% will get a B, 35% will get a C, 25% will get a D, and 15% will get an F. All students participated in the exam. The actual values were 22 students got an A, 18 got a B, 25 got a C, 15 got a D, and 20 got an F. What is the chi-square statistic?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Use the given expected percentages and observed counts. The observed counts sum to 22 + 18 + 25 + 15 + 20 = 100 students, so the expected counts are 10, 15, 35, 25, and 15 for A, B, C, D, and F respectively. Apply chi-square = sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected). Contributions: A: (22 - 10)^2 / 10 = 144 / 10 = 14.4. B: (18 - 15)^2 / 15 = 9 / 15 = 0.6. C: (25 - 35)^2 / 35 = 100 / 35 = 2.857142857. D: (15 - 25)^2 / 25 = 100 / 25 = 4. F: (20 - 15)^2 / 15 = 25 / 15 = 1.666666667. Sum = 14.4 + 0.6 + 2.857142857 + 4 + 1.666666667 = 23.523809524, which rounds to 23.52.

method.method_draft: Use the problem text to compute the chi-square statistic directly. Read the expected grade percentages as A=10%, B=15%, C=35%, D=25%, F=15%, and read the observed counts as A=22, B=18, C=25, D=15, F=20. Since all students participated, first sum the observed counts to get the class size: 22+18+25+15+20=100. Convert the expected percentages into expected counts out of 100: 10, 15, 35, 25, 15. Then apply the chi-square goodness-of-fit formula: sum over categories of (observed - expected)^2 / expected. Compute the contributions: (22-10)^2/10=14.4, (18-15)^2/15=0.6, (25-35)^2/35=2.857..., (15-25)^2/25=4, and (20-15)^2/15=1.666.... Sum them to get about 23.5238, which rounds to 23.52.
